scenario: Holding HOME opens the modes; a new mode asks first, shows its home and keeps the song
name: companion: a 1-bar loop with C4 recorded on CHORDS PLAY; HOME held opens the picker; SELECT to Guided, HOME, HOME confirms: Guided's first lesson, teal, while the song goes on; back to Producer the same way: PLAY's key lights again (C half), and the song is still there
note: 1 bar at 90 BPM is 2664 ms; the C4 recorded at about 1400 ms comes round at about 4064 and 6728 ms: the song goes on in Guided and is still there in Producer.
